lines.en: label yukispring6:
scene clearnightsky
Some nights, I try to separate myself from the outside world. I have done enough damage already.
lines.zh: 有些夜晚，我试图把自己与外面的世界隔开。我已经造成了足够多的伤害。

lines.en: And in {i}this{/i} world, where more things are broken than most even realize, the traces of my involvement still act as beacons illuminating the night sky with the flames of my misguided passion.
lines.zh: 而在{i}这个{/i}世界里，坏掉的东西比大多数人意识到的还要多，我参与过的痕迹依然像灯塔一样，用我误入歧途的激情之火照亮夜空。

lines.en: My appetite for destruction, even. That subtle, hidden craving within me, constantly poking and prodding me to bite not the hand that feeds but the hands of those who sit beneath it with their mouths agape.
lines.zh: 甚至是我对毁灭的胃口。那种藏在我体内、细微而隐秘的渴望，不停地戳着、推着我，让我不去咬那只喂食的手，而去咬那些张着嘴坐在它下面的手。

lines.en: Each and every one of us is seeking salvation. And whether that be in religious contexts or not matters little when everything is bigger under the lens of a magnifying glass.
lines.zh: 我们每一个人都在寻求救赎。而是否在宗教语境下，其实并不重要——因为在放大镜的镜片之下，一切都变得更大。

lines.en: Tonight is not one of those nights. But tonight is still different.
lines.zh: 今晚不是那样的夜晚。但今晚依然不同。

lines.en: For as I tap a green circle on a small box that keeps me connected to everything, I reach deep into my chest cavity and remove something I only take out for special occasions.
lines.zh: 因为当我点下那个让我与一切相连的小盒子上的绿色圆圈时，我把手深深伸进胸腔，取出了一件只在特殊场合才拿出来的东西。

lines.en: It’s a roll of metaphorical duct tape. And a small bottle of miraculous human glue.
lines.zh: 那是一卷比喻意义上的强力胶带。还有一小瓶神奇的人体胶水。

lines.en: These are things I will hold in my hands as someone else repairs what I can not — but I will deceive myself into thinking I have helped by standing to their side and pretending to know what is happening.
lines.zh: 在别人修补我修补不了的东西时，我会把它们捧在手里——但我也会自欺欺人地以为自己帮上了忙，只要站在他们旁边、装作知道正在发生什么。

lines.en: Forgive me Father, for she has sinned.
lines.zh: 原谅我，神父，因为她犯了罪。

lines.en: : Hello?
: Akira, yo. Heard you’re kinda famous now. Surprised you still picked up the phone.
lines.zh: : 哟，Akira。听说你现在有点名气了。没想到你还肯接电话。

lines.en: : Anything for my favorite recovering addict slash cancer patient. I’m going to charge you if you’re looking for an autograph, though.
lines.zh: : 为了我最喜欢的、正在康复的瘾君子兼癌症患者，什么都愿意做。不过你要是想找我要签名，我可是要收费的。

lines.en: : How much? I’ve got an endless piggy bank now that I’ve been sucked back into Nee-sama’s shit. Need a little more than an autograph, though.
lines.zh: : 多少？自从又被卷回姐姐大人的那些破事里，我就有个取之不尽的存钱罐了。不过我要的比签名多一点。

lines.en: : Then you’re in luck because my body is on permanent discount and I imagine that’s what you want instead.
lines.zh: : 那你走运了，因为我的身体永久打折，而我想你要的应该是这个。

lines.en: : Wrong again. Just need you to come with me on a little...errand.
lines.zh: : 又错了。只是需要你陪我去办点……小事。

lines.en: : Oh no. We’re not burying a body, are we? Is it Tsukasa’s? It was only a matter of time until Tsubasa found a new way to address the problem that is her existence. At least she isn’t heavy. Fine. I’m in.
lines.zh: : 哦不。我们不是要去埋尸体吧？是 Tsukasa 的吗？Tsubasa 迟早会想出新办法，来解决「她存在」这个问题。至少她不重。行。我去。

lines.en: : You done?
lines.zh: : 说完了？

lines.en: : Sorry. One of us has to be funny and I know it isn’t going to be you. You’re too cool and sad for that.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我们总得有一个人负责搞笑，而我知道那不会是你。你又酷又丧，干不了这个。

lines.en: : Okay, well I’m outside your house right now and you should get out here if you know what’s good for you.
lines.zh: : 好吧，我现在就在你家门外，你要是识相的话就出来。

lines.en: : If I don’t, will you break in and beat up my daughter? She could use it and I’m too weak to ever actually stand up to her.
lines.zh: : 我要是不出来，你会闯进来打我女儿吗？她确实该挨顿打，而我太弱了，根本反抗不了她。

lines.en: : Just fuckin’ come outside and humor me for a little, won’t ya? Without makin’ any more jokes.
lines.zh: : 你他妈出来陪我一会儿行不行？别再开玩笑了。

lines.en: : Well that doesn’t sound very humorous at all.
lines.zh: : 嗯，这听起来可一点也不好笑。

lines.en: : Make me wait any longer and I’m coming in there to kick {i}your{/i} ass instead of your daughter’s.
lines.zh: : 再让我等下去，我就进去揍{i}你{/i}，而不是揍你女儿。

lines.en: : You act like I wouldn’t like that.
lines.zh: : 说得好像我不会喜欢似的。

lines.en: : Ten more seconds or I’m calling Tsubasa.
lines.zh: : 再数十秒，我就给 Tsubasa 打电话。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes1
: Hi.
: Damn. You really {i}are{/i} afraid of her, huh?
lines.zh: : 该死。你{i}是{/i}真怕她啊？

lines.en: : I’m afraid of anyone with money. Plus, no one with boobs that big ever uses their powers for good.
lines.zh: : 我怕任何有钱的人。再说，胸部那么大的女人，没有一个是把能力用在正道上的。

lines.en: : Would say you’re wrong on account of the whole payin’ for my treatment shit. But I guess takin’ steps to put {i}me{/i} back out on the street ain’t exactly doing society any favors.
lines.zh: : 就凭她替我付治疗费这事儿，我本该说你错了。不过话说回来，采取措施把{i}我{/i}重新放回街上，也算不上给社会做了什么好事。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes2
: Anyway, hop on. We’re going for a ride.
lines.zh: : 总之，上车。我们兜风去。

lines.en: : Sure. I’ve more or less gotten over my fear of your motorcycle by now. I’d still like to know where we’re going, though.
lines.zh: : 行。我现在差不多已经克服对你那辆摩托的恐惧了。不过我还是想知道我们要去哪儿。

lines.en: : Somewhere I should’ve gone a long fuckin’ time ago, that’s where.
lines.zh: : 一个我他妈早就该去的地方，就是那儿。

lines.en: : Rehab?
lines.zh: : 戒毒所？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes3
: Oh, right. Forgot that was even a thing.
lines.zh: : 哦，对。我都忘了还有这回事。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes4
: But also, no. We’re goin’ to Sara’s place so I can apologize for being such a fuck up.
lines.zh: : 不过也不是。我们要去 Sara 那儿，好让我为自己这么废物道歉。

lines.en: : Oh. Well, why do you need {i}me{/i} for that?
lines.zh: : 哦。那你需要{i}我{/i}干嘛？

lines.en: : I guess I don’t {i}need{/i} you. But you were there when shit went to hell, so it seems only fair you should be there when that chapter is closed too.
lines.zh: : 我想我不{i}需要{/i}你。但事情变糟的时候你在场，所以这一章收尾的时候你也在场，好像才公平。

lines.en: : Plus, even I ain’t dumb enough to ride into battle alone. Apart from...all the times I’ve ridden into battle alone. But this is like...a {i}feelings{/i} battle. I don’t think I can use violence to make Sara forgive me.
lines.zh: : 再说，就连我也没蠢到会一个人上战场。除了……那些我一个人上战场的时候。不过这次像是……一场{i}感情{/i}的战斗。我觉得我没法用暴力让 Sara 原谅我。

lines.en: : You probably could with handcuffs and a whip or something. I think she might actually like that.
lines.zh: : 你也许可以用手铐和鞭子什么的。我觉得她搞不好真会喜欢。

lines.en: : Get on the fucking bike, Akira.
lines.zh: : 给我上车，Akira。

lines.en: scene black
: Fine, jeez. Just be careful driving around here. The roads are steep and- ah?!
lines.zh: : 行吧，天啊。开慢点，这一带路很陡，而——啊？！

lines.en: : Hang on, douche monkey! Only got so long before I need to be back at the manor!
lines.zh: : 抓稳了，蠢猴子！我得赶在回去宅邸之前！

lines.en: Yuki tears through the streets, almost killing several pedestrians in the process, but she somehow narrowly avoids them and only gives me a minor heart attack as a result.
lines.zh: Yuki 在街上飞驰，一路上差点撞死好几个行人，但她总能险险避开，最后只让我得了一次小型心脏病。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes5
It’s fine, though. Because it’s nothing a little alcohol and two miniature green-eyed girls can’t fix.
lines.zh: 不过没关系。因为一点酒精和两个绿眼睛的小丫头就能解决一切。

lines.en: Assuming this doesn’t get all sad and everyone winds up crying or something. Which is probably possible given the context. Just I don’t want to think about that, so I’ll imagine everyone is naked instead.
lines.zh: 前提是这趟别变得太伤感，搞得最后所有人都哭起来什么的。考虑到眼下的情况，这倒是有可能。只是我不想往那儿想，所以我会改成想象所有人都没穿衣服。

lines.en: : Mmm...boobs.
lines.zh: : Mmm……胸。

lines.en: : Can’t tell if I went so fast that I gave you brain damage or if you just came with it already installed.
lines.zh: : 我都分不清是我开得太快把你脑子撞坏了，还是你本来就这样。

lines.en: : Shut up. You’re interrupting my fantasy.
lines.zh: : 闭嘴。你打断我的幻想了。

lines.en: : Hey! Welcome to- {i}oh.{/i}
lines.zh: : 嘿！欢迎光——{i}哦{/i}。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes6
: It’s just you...
lines.zh: : 是你啊……

lines.en: : Uhh...{i}hi.{/i}
: This is...somewhat...unexpected.
lines.zh: : 这……有点……出乎意料。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes7
: Yeah...uhh...hey.
: Sorry for not callin’ ahead of time or anything, but...I wanted to drop by and, like...you know.
lines.zh: : 抱歉没提前打招呼什么的，不过……我想顺路过来，那个……你知道的。

lines.en: : Wh...Where is everybody?
lines.zh: : 大……大家都去哪儿了？

lines.en: : This {i}is{/i} everybody. We’ve been in a steady decline ever since a certain bartender decided to stop showing up.
lines.zh: : 这就{i}是{/i}所有人了。自从某个酒保决定不来了，我们就一路在走下坡路。

lines.en: : When did you dye your hair? I like it.
lines.zh: : 你什么时候染的发？我喜欢。

lines.en: : Don’t give her any compliments, Sana.
lines.zh: : 别夸她，Sana。

lines.en: : Sorry. I meant I don’t like it.
lines.zh: : 抱歉。我的意思是我不喜欢。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes8
: That’s more like it. You need to be careful with girls like her, Sana. You show the faintest sign of weakness or affection and they just take advantage of you. Isn’t that right, Yuki?
lines.zh: : 这才对。跟她这种女孩你得小心，Sana。你只要露出一丁点软弱或感情的苗头，她们就会趁机利用你。我说的没错吧，Yuki？

lines.en: : Sara...you know I’m...here to apologize, right?
lines.zh: : Sara……你知道我是……来道歉的吧？

lines.en: : Oh, are you? Excuse me for not realizing it.
lines.zh: : 哦，是吗？抱歉我没看出来。

lines.en: : It’s just that most people normally apologize within a year of doing something wrong and {i}you{/i} decided to cut me out entirely. So you can get lost for all I care.
lines.zh: : 只是大多数人通常在做错事的一年之内道歉，而{i}你{/i}选择把我彻底切掉。所以你爱滚哪儿滚哪儿，我不在乎。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes9
: Can I...get you a drink, Sensei? I feel like...the two of us should maybe...try to stay out of this, if possible...
lines.zh: : 老师……要我给你拿杯酒吗？我觉得……我们俩也许该……尽量别掺和进去，如果可以的话……

lines.en: : You’re affected by this too, Sana. So if you’d also like to yell at Yuki for all of the extra hours you’ve been forced to work because of her, I won’t mind at all.
lines.zh: : 你也受影响了，Sana。所以如果你也想因为她害你被迫加了那么多班而冲 Yuki 吼，我一点都不介意。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes10
: I mean...I basically just...went back to the same schedule I was...working {i}before{/i} she was here, so...
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我基本只是……回到了她来{i}之前{/i}我……排的那个班，所以……

lines.en: : {i}Ahem.{/i}
scene yukiapologizes11
: S...Sorry...What I meant to say is...you’re a bitch and...I hate you...
lines.zh: : 抱、抱歉……我想说的是……你是个婊子，而且……我恨你……

lines.en: : I {i}will{/i} take a beer, Sana. But I’d like it over there in the corner of the room so I can get out of the blast radius.
lines.zh: : 给我来杯啤酒，Sana。不过我想端到房间角落那边去，好让我躲开爆炸半径。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes12
: Oh, thank god.
lines.zh: : 哦，谢天谢地。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes13
: Sara-
lines.zh: : Sara——

lines.en: : Hmph.
scene yukiapologizes14
: Can we please, just...{i}talk?{/i} I won’t take long. And I don’t expect you to forgive me or anything, I’ve just...got some shit I need to say.
lines.zh: : 我们能……就……{i}谈谈吗{/i}？不会占你太久。我也不指望你原谅我什么的，我只是……有些话得说。

lines.en: : Well, {i}I{/i} don’t. I’ve already said all there is to say to you. And I’m not going to let you trick me into caring again knowing you’ll just throw me away the second you find it convenient.
lines.zh: : 可{i}我{/i}不想。该对你说的我都说完了。而且我不会再让你骗得我在乎你——明知道你一觉得方便就会把我扔掉。

lines.en: : I ain’t trying to trick you. And you can throw me out whenever the fuck you want. But at least give me the chance to talk some shit about {i}myself{/i} first. It ain’t fair if you’re hoggin’ all the negativity.
lines.zh: : 我不是在骗你。你想什么时候把我扔出去都行。但至少先给我个机会，让我先说{i}自己{/i}几句坏话。负能量都让你一个人占了，这不公平。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes15
: I gave you plenty of chances, Yuki. Far more chances than anyone {i}should{/i} have given you.
lines.zh: : 我给过你很多机会了，Yuki。比任何人{i}该{/i}给的都多得多。

lines.en: : And you know what that did for me? Nothing but heartbreak and betrayal and finding out that people like you really {i}are{/i} all the same at the end of the day.
lines.zh: : 而你知道那给我带来了什么？只有心碎和背叛，还有发现像你这样的人到头来{i}真的{/i}全都一个样。

lines.en: : You just take and take until there’s nothing left and then vanish like it never mattered at all.
lines.zh: : 你只是一直拿、一直拿，直到什么都不剩，然后就消失，好像这一切从来都不重要。

lines.en: : So why should I waste my precious time on someone who’s already made it known they don’t give a shit about me? Huh?
lines.zh: : 那我凭什么要把宝贵的时间，浪费在一个早就表明过不在乎我的人身上？嗯？

lines.en: : You ain’t gotta do anything if you don’t want to. And you’ve got every right to hate me right now...
lines.zh: : 你不想做就什么都不用做。而且你现在完全有权利恨我……

lines.en: : But I’ve realized lately just how fast life moves by, and I don’t want to leave this place without apologizing to you first.
lines.zh: : 可我最近才意识到人生过得多快，而我不想连句道歉都没留下就离开这个世界。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes16
: Oh, cry me a river. You’re making it sound like you’re dying or something when we all know you’re just desperate for money again and-
lines.zh: : 哦，别跟我哭天抢地的。你说得好像自己要死了似的，可我们都知道你只是又缺钱了，而且——

lines.en: : Sara, I’ve got cancer.
lines.zh: : Sara，我得了癌症。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes17
: It ain’t, like...a {i}death{/i} sentence or anything. But it’s made me start lookin’ at shit a little differently and...I don’t know...
lines.zh: : 这也不是什么……{i}死刑{/i}判决之类的。但它让我开始用不一样的眼光看事情，而且……我也不知道……

lines.en: : I just want to say sorry for everything...
lines.zh: : 我只是想为一切说声对不起……

lines.en: : But if you really don’t want me here, I’ll just-
lines.zh: : 但如果你真的不想让我在这儿，我就——

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes18
: Sana.
lines.zh: : Sana。

lines.en: scene black
: Watch the bar for me.
lines.zh: : 替我看着店。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes19
: I’m sorry, Yuki. I...didn’t know.
lines.zh: : 对不起，Yuki。我……不知道。

lines.en: : Ain’t nothin’ you need to apologize for. That’s why I came {i}here,{/i} remember?
lines.zh: : 你没什么需要道歉的。我{i}来{/i}的目的就是这个，记得吗？

lines.en: : I know, but...I at least could have been a little kinder with my words if I knew.
lines.zh: : 我知道，不过……要是早知道，我至少可以把话说得温和一点。

lines.en: : Is it...bad?
lines.zh: : 严重吗？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes20
: Well, it definitely ain’t {i}good.{/i} But I’m seeing doctors and shit, so...trying to stay optimistic.
lines.zh: : 嗯，肯定算不上{i}好{/i}。不过我在看医生什么的，所以……尽量保持乐观。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, but...if you need money, I don’t have much to spare and-
lines.zh: : 抱歉，不过……如果你需要钱，我也没多少能匀出来，而且——

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes21
: Huh? No, I...No, no, no, no, no, no. That’s not it at all. I don’t need money. That ain’t why I’m here.
lines.zh: : 哈？不，我……不不不不不不。根本不是那么回事。我不需要钱。我来这儿不是为了钱。

lines.en: : But...the whole reason you started working here in the first place was because you were broke. What do you mean you don’t need money?
lines.zh: : 可……你当初来这儿工作的全部原因，就是你身无分文。你说你不需要钱是什么意思？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes22
: I’ve got a friend with more cash than she knows what to do with. And she’s payin’ for everything. Even gave me a place to live and...
lines.zh: : 我有个朋友，钱多得不知道该怎么花。她替我付了所有费用。甚至还给了我一处住的地方，而且……

lines.en: : I’m doin’ better now. I still ain’t perfect, but I’m better. Just...remains to be seen how long it’ll last this time and...if I even {i}will{/i} last. You know?
lines.zh: : 我现在好多了。我依然算不上完美，但我好多了。只是……这次能撑多久还不好说，还有……我到底还{i}能{/i}撑多久。你懂的吧？

lines.en: : Yuki...if you’re just saying all of this so I won’t have to worry, it’s not going to work. I might be mad at you, but I still {i}care.{/i}
lines.zh: : Yuki……如果你说这些只是为了让我不用操心，那是没用的。我也许在生你的气，但我还是{i}在乎{/i}你。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes23
: I know...You took a chance on me when nobody else would. And I ain’t ever gonna forget that, no matter {i}how{/i} fucked up on drugs or anything else I get.
lines.zh: : 我知道……在没人愿意的时候，是你赌了我一把。而我永远不会忘记这一点，不管我嗑药嗑得{i}多{/i}烂，还是别的什么。

lines.en: : This ain’t a lie, though. And I know that probably don’t mean much, but it really ain’t. Could even have her confirm it if you really want me to. Just...want to avoid that if possible since {i}she{/i} can be a lot too.
lines.zh: : 不过这不是谎话。我知道这话大概没什么分量，但它真的不是。你要是真想，我甚至可以让她来作证。只是……尽量想避免，因为{i}她{/i}也很难搞。

lines.en: : And you trust her? Because this is a big deal, Yuki. This is your life we’re talking about.
lines.zh: : 而你信任她？因为这不是小事，Yuki。我们谈的是你的命。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes24
: I trust her, yeah. Known her for...damn, over half of my life now. Time really flies, huh?
lines.zh: : 我信任她，嗯。认识她……操，都超过我半辈子了。时间过得真快啊？

lines.en: : Yeah...it really does.
lines.zh: : 是啊……真的很快。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes25
: Anyway, I didn’t come here to try and make you feel bad for me or anything. I just wanted to apologize for the whole...relapsing and...ghosting the bar ordeal. I know you needed the help.
lines.zh: : 总之，我来这儿不是为了让你可怜我什么的。我只是想为……复吸还有……人间蒸发不来店里这件事道歉。我知道你当时需要人手。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes26
: Yuki, wha...no! That was never the issue! Do you really think {i}that’s{/i} what you need to apologize for?! Do you think {i}that’s{/i} why I’m so upset?!
lines.zh: : Yuki，什……不！问题从来不是这个！你真觉得你要道歉的是{i}这个{/i}吗？！你以为我是因为{i}这个{/i}才这么生气吗？！

lines.en: : Uhhhhhhh...no? But just so we’re both on the same page, can you tell me why you {i}are?{/i}
lines.zh: : 呃呃呃……不是？不过为了我们俩达成共识，你能告诉我你为什么{i}生气{/i}吗？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes27
: Because you wouldn’t let me be there for you when you needed it most! You basically told me to go fuck myself for caring about you! Do you not understand how much that hurts?!
lines.zh: : 因为在我最需要陪伴的时候，你不让我陪在你身边！你基本上就是叫我去操我自己，就因为我关心你！你不知道这有多伤人吗？！

lines.en: : And I {i}know{/i} you had your reasons! My parents were raging alcoholics and I understand addiction. But it’s {i}because{/i} I understand it that I can’t be around people who don’t want to fight back!
lines.zh: : 我也{i}知道{/i}你有你的理由！我父母都是烂醉如泥的酒鬼，我懂成瘾。可正{i}因为{/i}懂，我才没法待在那些不想反抗的人身边！

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes28
: I never expected you to stay clean forever. And if you want to say that’s fucked up on my part or whatever, fine. I guess it kind of is. That’s just the way this works, though.
lines.zh: : 我从来没指望你永远保持干净。你想说这是我这边很操蛋什么的，行。我想确实有点。不过这事儿就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : But if you’re going to be fighting {i}two{/i} diseases now instead of just one, you need to understand that when people that care about you reach out to help, it’s not because they’re looking for a {i}cure.{/i}
lines.zh: : 但如果你现在要同时对抗{i}两{/i}种病，而不是一种，你就得明白：当在乎你的人伸出手来帮忙时，那不是因为他们在找{i}解药{/i}。

lines.en: : It’s because they don’t want to watch you suffer. And they’re willing to sacrifice a little of their own happiness if it means letting you feel it.
lines.zh: : 而是因为他们不想眼睁睁看着你受苦。而且如果那样能让你感受到，他们愿意牺牲一点自己的幸福。

lines.en: : {i}That’s{/i} why I’m sad. Because you rejected me.
lines.zh: : {i}所以{/i}我才难过。因为你拒绝了我。

lines.en: : And I’m sure you think you were just saving me pain by doing that, but you only wound up making it worse by subjecting me to watch as you torched everything you worked so hard for.
lines.zh: : 我敢肯定你以为那样做是在替我省下痛苦，可你只是让事情更糟——你逼着我眼睁睁看着你把自己拼命换来的一切一把火烧掉。

lines.en: : Damn...I can’t even be a fuck-up without fucking it up. I didn’t know you felt that way, Sara. Never realized...how much you cared, I guess.
lines.zh: : 操……我连做个废物都能把废物做砸。我不知道你是这么想的，Sara。我想我从没意识到……你有多在乎。

lines.en: : Then apologize for {i}that.{/i} Because that’s the apology I want. A job is just a job. There are bars all over Kumon-mi, but there’s only {i}one{/i} of you.
lines.zh: : 那就为{i}这个{/i}道歉。因为我想要的是这个道歉。工作只是工作。Kumon-mi 到处都是酒吧，但你只有{i}一个{/i}。

lines.en: : I’m sorry, Sara. I really am. For...{i}everything.{/i} Apologizing for just {i}one{/i} thing feels like it ain’t nearly enough. So...guess I’ll apologize for apologizin’ about stuff you don’t want me to apologize for too. That work?
lines.zh: : 对不起，Sara。真的。为……{i}一切{/i}。只为{i}一件{/i}事道歉，感觉根本不够。所以……那我也顺便为那些你不想让我道歉的事道歉吧。这样行吗？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes29
: Yeah...
: That works...
lines.zh: : 这样就行……

lines.en: : Don’t you fuckin’ cry on me, idiot. I ain’t done shit to earn those tears.
lines.zh: : 别他妈在我面前哭，白痴。我可什么都没做，配不上你这些眼泪。

lines.en: : Stop thinking you need to {i}earn{/i} everything and just take what people are willing to give you. You’re so...{i}fucking{/i} annoying sometimes.
lines.zh: : 别总以为什么都要靠{i}挣{/i}来的，别人愿意给你的，你就收下。你有时候真{i}他妈{/i}……烦人。

lines.en: : Also, please don’t die. I’m not good with funerals.
lines.zh: : 还有，拜托别死。我不擅长参加葬礼。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes30
: I’ll do my best.
lines.zh: : 我尽量。

lines.en: : Been fightin’ my whole life. Kinda fucked up how I even {i}considered{/i} stopping for this one when it’s the biggest challenge yet.
lines.zh: : 我这辈子一直在打。想想还挺操蛋的，明明这是至今最大的一场硬仗，我居然还{i}想过{/i}要在这场上停下来。

lines.en: : How long have you known?...
lines.zh: : 你知道多久了？……

lines.en: : Since about...five hours before I relapsed, maybe? When was that? I can’t remember for reasons you’re probably aware of already.
lines.zh: : 大概……是我复吸前五个小时？那是什么时候来着？我记不清了，原因你大概也清楚。

lines.en: : Was that why?...
lines.zh: : 是因为那个吗？……

lines.en: : It was.
: But if it wasn’t that, it would’ve been somethin’ else eventually. You said it yourself. That’s just how this works.
lines.zh: : 不过就算不是那个，迟早也会是别的什么。你自己说过的。这事儿就是这么运作的。

lines.en: : That’s just how this works...
lines.zh: : 这事儿就是这么运作的……

lines.en: : I’ll need you to clock in an hour early tomorrow.
lines.zh: : 明天你需要提前一小时打卡上班。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes31
: Wait, what?
lines.zh: : 等等，什么？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes32
: You heard me. Don’t think I’ll be cutting your hours just because you have cancer.
lines.zh: : 你听清了。别以为你得了癌症我就会给你减少工时。

lines.en: : But...I didn’t ask for the job back. I don’t {i}need{/i} the job anymore.
lines.zh: : 可……我又没要求复职。我不再{i}需要{/i}这份工作了。

lines.en: : Oh? So you work one part-time job and then escape the workforce entirely all because you have some rich friend? Sorry, Yuki. I just figured you might want some sort of purpose in life.
lines.zh: : 哦？所以你打了一份兼职，然后就因为有某个有钱的朋友，彻底退出劳动力市场了？抱歉啊，Yuki。我只是以为你也许想要一点人生目标。

lines.en: : The fuck is this? You didn’t even want to see me like thirty minutes ago. Now you’re forcin’ me to come back to work?
lines.zh: : 这他妈算什么？三十分钟前你还根本不想见我。现在你倒逼我回来上班？

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes33
: Yes. You owe me. And if you {i}really{/i} want to show me you’re sorry, you’ll work for free for your first month back. Understood?
lines.zh: : 对。你欠我的。如果你{i}真{/i}想让我看到你的歉意，回来的第一个月你就免费干活。明白吗？

lines.en: : I mean...I {i}do{/i} understand. But-
lines.zh: : 我的意思是……我{i}确实{/i}明白。可是——

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes34

: But what? You hate me and only came here to tie up loose ends before spending the rest of your life waiting for death? Because that’s how I’ll interpret anything but, “Okay, Sara. I’ll clock in early tomorrow.”
lines.zh: : 可是什么？你恨我，来这儿只是为了在余生等死之前把尾巴收干净？因为除了「好的，Sara。我明天提前来打卡」之外的任何话，我都会这么理解。

lines.en: : This feels sorta like emotional blackmail.
lines.zh: : 这感觉有点像情感勒索。

lines.en: : Well, Yuki, that’s because it is.
lines.zh: : 嗯，Yuki，因为它就是。

lines.en: : Wow. I...I didn’t realize you had it in you.
lines.zh: : 哇。我……我不知道你还有这一手。

lines.en: scene yukiapologizes35
: Guess I’ll just...clock in early tomorrow. Not sure how I’m going to explain this to Nee-sama, though.
lines.zh: : 那我就……明天提前来打卡吧。不过我还没想好怎么跟姐姐大人解释。

lines.en: : {i}Nee-sama,{/i} huh? I don’t think I’ve heard you address someone that formally before. Should I be jealous?
lines.zh: : {i}姐姐大人{/i}，是吧？我不记得听你这么正式地称呼过谁。我该吃醋吗？

lines.en: : I don’t think so. But she’s sure as fuck about to be jealous of you since it means I’m spending less time on her leash.
lines.zh: : 我觉得不用。不过她肯定他妈的要嫉妒你了，因为这意味着我待在她牵引绳上的时间变少了。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like {i}I{/i} should invest in a leash as well, then.
lines.zh: : 听起来{i}我{/i}是不是也该投资一条牵引绳了。

lines.en: : Sounds to me like I’m due for another relapse.
lines.zh: : 听起来我是不是又该复吸了。

lines.en: scene black
: Sounds to me like I should invest in a cage too.
lines.zh: : 听起来我是不是也该投资一个笼子。

lines.en: : Please don’t. I’m already trapped in one.
lines.zh: : 拜托别。我已经被关在一个里面了。
